title: webContents.findInPage stops emitting found-in-page after reload
body:
### Electron Version

32.0.0

### What operating system(s) are you using?

macOS

### Operating System Version

macOS 14.7

### Expected Behavior

Searching emits found-in-page after every page load.

### Actual Behavior

After one reload, findInPage returns an integer request id but the found-in-page listener never receives a result.

### Testcase Gist URL

_No response_

### Additional Information

Only a one-line call is available: win.webContents.findInPage("orange").
